measurement: platform + psutil under same shell Python as benchmark
limitations: Performance is host-specific, not disk-cold; independent CLI includes startup and open.
RSS is 5ms-polled observed process maximum, not precise allocation or guaranteed whole-run peak.
Reused process RSS covers all workloads, not per-query allocations.
Unicode acceptance was executed with CPython UCD16, not every supported Python version.
A separate tool Python lacked psutil; that failed probe was not used for these environment values.
